name: Tsunade Senju
source:
Tsunade is a descendant of the Senju and Uzumaki Clan, and is one of Konohagakure's Sannin. Tsunade is a fair-skinned woman with brown eyes and straight blonde hair. She is famed as the world's strongest kunoichi and its greatest medical-nin. The repeated loss of her loved ones caused Tsunade to later abandon the life of a shinobi for many years. But, She is persuaded to return to Konoha and take on the mantle of Fifth Hokage where her skills prove invaluable to the village.

[In game description]
